ud7.7:0.2: Ud 7:7 The Ending of Objectification (Papañcakhaya Sutta)
ud7.7:1.2: on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Sāvatthī at Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
ud7.7:1.3: And on that occasion the Blessed One was sitting, contemplating his own abandoning of the perceptions & categories of objectification.
ud7.7:2.1: Then the Blessed One, realizing his own abandoning of the perceptions & categories of objectification, on that occasion exclaimed:
ud7.7:3.1:
One who
has no objectifications,
no standing-place,
ud7.7:3.2:
who has gone beyond
the tether & cross-bar:
ud7.7:3.3:
The world, even with its devas,
doesn’t look down on him–
he, going about without craving,
a sage.
